cause_quote: The change added `this.eventProjection.handleRetry(params)` under `if (params.willRetry === true)`, emitting `stream: "run_status"` with `phase: "retrying"` while the channel reply handler had no branch for that stream.
user_saw: Telegram users saw only a typing indicator while Codex retried a model request.
summary: The fix routes Codex retry events through channel progress previews so a single retry notice appears and clears when the reply arrives.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and its channel reply handler: the parent skipped `willRetry` notifications, and #139397 began emitting retry status without forwarding it to channel previews. The later local-model progress change forwarded only waits in the `waiting_for_model` phase, leaving Codex retry notices absent.
